chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Back at the Nest Club with Dave Nelson, Slick Jones and Lloyd Phillips
summary: After six months of Nest Club, Rhythm Club and Broadway, Danny rejoined Dave Nelson's band, with Slick Jones and the pianist Phillips.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: All right, in six months, I had been in the Nest Club, the Rhythm Club, I'd been on Broadway -- and I'm back in the Nest Club again. And up over the Nest Club, Smitty... No, Slick Jones is now working there....
Slick Jones was a drummer, too.
A drummer who worked with Fats Waller. And Slick Jones wife was a nice performer. Can't think of her name now. Well, we're in this band, Dave Nelson's band. Lawrence Phillips is in this band, too.
Yeah. So we get to be tight, and I'm beginning to understand what great piano playing is all about.
